Pubic liposuction es un tratamiento de cirugía plástica indicado para eliminar el exceso de grasa en la zona púbica y mejorar el contorno corporal. En Clínica Belba realizamos este procedimiento con un enfoque personalizado, adaptado a cada paciente.

How much does liposuction of the mons pubis cost in Barcelona?

The price of a Venus mound liposuction It's not usually the same in all cases, as it depends on various clinical and surgical factors. Treating a small localized fat deposit is not the same as correcting a more pronounced bulge or combining surgery with a pubic lift.
